# OpenHelvetia platform ontology (oh:)

**Version:** 0.0.9 · **Version IRI:** `https://ld.openhelvetia.swiss/schema/0.1/` · **Namespace:** `https://ld.openhelvetia.swiss/schema/`

Status: 0.x draft, not binding before ratification by the standards commission (Art. 13 statutes). The AI-interface module carried by this ontology (MCP/A2A interface descriptors) is the FOURTH commission candidate (E16 consequence 3), alongside the skill format (E8), portable agent memory (E7) and the engine standard (E15).

Deprecation policy (E16 no. 5e — deprecation only with a transition period): terms are NEVER removed from this file. A deprecated term keeps its IRI and its declaration, receives owl:deprecated true plus a skos:note naming the replacement term and the transition period during which both terms remain served. Published versions are immutable; every change is a new owl:versionIRI (SemVer in owl:versionInfo).

## Imported terms

Foreign terms are referenced, never re-declared (see `imports/README.md` for the canonical specs):

- **cube:** cube:Cube, cube:Observation
- **dcat:** dcat:Catalog, dcat:CatalogRecord, dcat:DataService, dcat:Dataset, dcat:endpointDescription, dcat:endpointURL, dcat:keyword, dcat:landingPage, dcat:record, dcat:servesDataset
- **dct:** dct:conformsTo, dct:description, dct:isVersionOf, dct:issued, dct:license, dct:modified, dct:publisher, dct:title
- **eli:** eli:LegalResource
- **org:** org:ChangeEvent, org:Organization, org:changedBy, org:resultedFrom
- **prov:** prov:Activity, prov:Agent, prov:Attribution, prov:Entity, prov:actedOnBehalfOf, prov:qualifiedAttribution, prov:wasAssociatedWith, prov:wasAttributedTo
- **skos:** skos:exactMatch, skos:note

## Classes

### oh:AgentCardEnvelope

**Agent-card envelope** — The registry's exchange and record format for an A2A 1.0 agent card (card spec v0.1): it embeds the card (oh:card) and carries the two separated trust blocks (oh:authenticity, oh:attestation). A prov:Entity because it is the thing the two attributions qualify.

- Subclass of: `prov:Entity`

### oh:Attestation

**Attestation** — Verein verification block: the association verified the operator out of band, at a stated level, at a stated time, with a stated expiry. Subclass of prov:Attribution: the qualified ascription of the verification claim to the VEREIN agent, bound to the exact card verified (JCS-bound signing input, card spec v0.1). Expiry moves an entry along the lifecycle gradient (grace, quarantine) — it never delists.

- Subclass of: `prov:Attribution`

### oh:AuthPolicy

**Auth policy** — The declared authentication requirement of an interface (the manifest's auth block): an oh:authType value plus optional oh:documentation.

### oh:Authenticity

**Authenticity** — Operator signature block: whoever controls the domain-anchored key signed exactly this card — content integrity and key continuity, never legal entity (E09 no. 3). Subclass of prov:Attribution: it is the qualified ascription of the card to the OPERATOR agent, carrying the signature evidence (oh:signature, oh:keyRef, oh:signedAt). Disjoint with oh:Attestation — two fields, never one (E09 no. 5): different signers, different claims, different lifecycles, different revocation surfaces.

- Subclass of: `prov:Attribution`
- Disjoint with: `oh:Attestation`

### oh:ChangeEvent

**Change event** — A change event with its own URI (/org/{id}/event/{id}): municipal mergers and registry history are modelled identically (E16 no. 5b). Subclass of org:ChangeEvent so standard W3C-org tooling reads platform history unchanged; the E14 anchor-renewal rule (predecessor/ successor relation, orderly relay hand-over of dying domains) hangs off these events via org:changedBy / org:resultedFrom.

- Subclass of: `org:ChangeEvent`
- See also: `oh:Organization`, `oh:RegistryEntry`

### oh:DetachedJws

**Detached JWS** — A detached JWS (RFC 7515): protected header and signature only; the payload is reconstructed by the verifier via JCS (RFC 8785) from the content actually received. Carries oh:jwsProtected and oh:jwsSignature.

### oh:Directory

**Directory** — The published directory index (directory envelope v0.2): a catalog of registry entries. The directory is DERIVED data — on any divergence the manifest governs (oh:authority).

- Subclass of: `dcat:Catalog`

### oh:DownloadInterface

**Download interface** — Dumps/distributions of the holding. Modelled as a service (access point with an endpoint), not as dcat:Distribution: the manifest names the place to fetch from, cf. dcat:accessService.

- Subclass of: `oh:Interface`

### oh:Interface

**Interface** — Common superclass of the four AI-interface classes (McpInterface, SparqlInterface, RestInterface, DownloadInterface). Subclass of dcat:DataService: every interface is an addressable service with an endpoint that serves the manifest's holding (DCAT direction: dcat:servesDataset from service to dataset; oh:interface is the profile's dataset-to-service arrangement, see there).

- Subclass of: `dcat:DataService`

### oh:KeyRef

**Key reference** — Key discovery reference (E09 no. 1 — DNS+TLS anchor): a JWK Set under the signing organisation's own domain well-known (oh:jwksUri) plus the key id within it (oh:kid).

### oh:Manifest

**Manifest** — A registry manifest: the versioned, canonical description of ONE holding together with its access services (Registry-as-Code, manifest standard v0.1). Subclass of dcat:Dataset because the manifest's subject is the holding itself — the stable dataset being described — while each entry of oh:interface is a dcat:DataService serving that dataset. This keeps the profile a strict DCAT-AP-CH refinement: dataset-level tooling (opendata.swiss harvesting, LINDAS) reads the manifest unchanged, and the service level is carried in addition (E16 consequence 4: harvesting currently drops dcat:DataService — it lives on in this profile).

- Subclass of: `dcat:Dataset`

### oh:McpInterface

**MCP interface** — An MCP server offered for the holding; the MCP spec version is carried in dct:conformsTo (manifest standard v0.1).

- Subclass of: `oh:Interface`

### oh:Organization

**Organization** — A publishing organisation with a timeless identity URI (/org/{id}; the stable internal ID is separate from the display slug, E14). Municipalities and other federal entities are never maintained twice: skos:exactMatch links to their ld.admin.ch URIs; oh: adds only what the platform itself asserts.

- Subclass of: `org:Organization`

### oh:OrganizationVersion

**Organization version** — A citable, immutable version of an organisation description (/org/{id}/version/{n}; version.link/JOLux time model, E16 no. 5b). Linked to its timeless identity via oh:versionOf.

- See also: `oh:Organization`, `oh:versionOf`

### oh:Probe

**Probe** — Liveness-probe hint (L0.8 cold-start hardening): the minimal harmless call proving an interface is alive, so a cold-start agent never has to guess a safe request. Carries oh:probeKind, oh:probeExpect and optionally oh:probeTarget.

### oh:RegistryEntry

**Registry entry** — A directory entry with a timeless identity URI (/registry/{slug}). Subclass of dcat:CatalogRecord: the entry is the catalog's registration record ABOUT a manifest (its projections name, description, publisher, license mirror manifest fields), not the described resource itself — oh:manifest links to the authoritative manifest.

- Subclass of: `dcat:CatalogRecord`

### oh:RegistryEntryVersion

**Registry entry version** — A citable, immutable version of a registry entry (/registry/{slug}/version/{semver}), derived from git tags of the registry repo — the tag IS the version event (Registry-as-Code). Linked to its timeless identity via oh:versionOf.

- See also: `oh:RegistryEntry`, `oh:versionOf`

### oh:RestInterface

**REST interface** — A REST API over the holding; the OpenAPI reference is carried in oh:documentation.

- Subclass of: `oh:Interface`

### oh:SparqlInterface

**SPARQL interface** — A SPARQL endpoint over the holding.

- Subclass of: `oh:Interface`

## Object properties

### oh:attestation

**attestation** — The envelope's Verein-verification block (optional — 'signed but not yet verified' is a normal state). Subproperty of prov:qualifiedAttribution: it qualifies the envelope's attribution to the attesting Verein.

- Subproperty of: `prov:qualifiedAttribution`
- Domain: `oh:AgentCardEnvelope`
- Range: `oh:Attestation`

### oh:auth

**auth** — The interface's declared authentication requirement (mandatory per interface, manifest standard v0.1).

- Domain: `oh:Interface`
- Range: `oh:AuthPolicy`

### oh:authenticity

**authenticity** — The envelope's operator-signature block (mandatory). Subproperty of prov:qualifiedAttribution: it qualifies the envelope's attribution to the operator.

- Subproperty of: `prov:qualifiedAttribution`
- Domain: `oh:AgentCardEnvelope`
- Range: `oh:Authenticity`

### oh:card

**card** — The embedded A2A 1.0 agent card. Its interior is owned by A2A 1.0 and strictly validated against the A2A schema in a separate step (E16 no. 6) — this ontology deliberately declares no terms for the card's content and asserts no range (A2A publishes no RDF vocabulary to align to).

- Domain: `oh:AgentCardEnvelope`

### oh:documentation

**documentation** — Human- or machine-readable documentation for the subject (interface docs, auth docs, entry docs). Kept as one deliberately broad property; relates to dcat:endpointDescription (service docs) and dcat:landingPage (dataset page) without committing to either domain.

- See also: `dcat:endpointDescription`, `dcat:landingPage`

### oh:entry

**entry** — Relates the directory to one of its registry entries; subproperty of dcat:record (catalog to catalog record).

- Subproperty of: `dcat:record`
- Domain: `oh:Directory`
- Range: `oh:RegistryEntry`

### oh:interface

**interface** — Relates a described holding (oh:Manifest) or a directory projection (oh:RegistryEntry) to one of its typed access services. Profile arrangement of the DCAT service link — DCAT itself points from service to dataset via dcat:servesDataset; no inverse axiom is asserted because not every serving service is a declared interface.

- Range: `oh:Interface`
- See also: `dcat:servesDataset`

### oh:keyRef

**key reference** — The key discovery reference of a trust block.

- Range: `oh:KeyRef`

### oh:legalBasis

**legal basis** — The statutory basis of the holding, pointing to the legislation as an ELI legal resource (Fedlex URIs); analogue of DCAT-AP's applicable-legislation property, expressed against ELI directly.

- Range: `eli:LegalResource`

### oh:manifest

**manifest** — Links a registry entry to its authoritative manifest (byte-identical sibling, directory envelope v0.2). Authority rule: on any divergence between entry projections and the manifest, the manifest governs.

- Domain: `oh:RegistryEntry`
- Range: `oh:Manifest`

### oh:probe

**probe** — The interface's liveness-probe hint (optional; L0.8).

- Domain: `oh:Interface`
- Range: `oh:Probe`

### oh:probeTarget

**probe target** — Optional probe URL when it differs from the interface endpoint.

- Domain: `oh:Probe`

### oh:signature

**signature** — The detached JWS of a trust block (authenticity or attestation); signing inputs are JCS-canonical (card spec v0.1, normative).

- Range: `oh:DetachedJws`

### oh:versionOf

**version of** — Links a citable, immutable version resource to its timeless identity (version.link/JOLux pattern, E16 no. 5b); subproperty of dct:isVersionOf.

- Subproperty of: `dct:isVersionOf`
- See also: `oh:RegistryEntryVersion`, `oh:OrganizationVersion`

## Datatype properties

### oh:attestationLevel

**attestation level** — The verification level of an attestation (a gradient, never a binary badge — E14(b)); one of the closed oh:AttestationLevelValue set. Ontology name for the card envelope's 'level' field.

- Domain: `oh:Attestation`
- Range: `oh:AttestationLevelValue`

### oh:authType

**auth type** — The kind of authentication an interface requires; one of the closed oh:AuthTypeValue set.

- Domain: `oh:AuthPolicy`
- Range: `oh:AuthTypeValue`

### oh:authority

**authority** — Machine-readable divergence rule of the directory envelope: names the artefact class that governs when derived data and source disagree.

- Domain: `oh:Directory`
- Range: `xsd:string`
- Notes:
  - Allowed value 'manifest': the manifest is the authoritative source; the directory index is derived from it (directory envelope v0.2).

### oh:expiresAt

**expires at** — Expiry of the attestation (RFC 3339, UTC). Expiry moves the entry along the lifecycle gradient (grace, then quarantine) — it never delists.

- Domain: `oh:Attestation`
- Range: `xsd:dateTime`

### oh:jwksUri

**JWKS URI** — HTTPS URL of the JWK Set on the signing organisation's own domain (DNS+TLS anchor, E09 no. 1).

- Domain: `oh:KeyRef`
- Range: `xsd:anyURI`

### oh:jwsProtected

**JWS protected header** — The base64url-encoded JWS protected header (RFC 7515); must contain 'alg' and 'kid'. Ontology name for the detached-JWS 'protected' field.

- Domain: `oh:DetachedJws`
- Range: `xsd:string`

### oh:jwsSignature

**JWS signature** — The base64url-encoded JWS signature value (RFC 7515). Ontology name for the detached-JWS 'signature' field (distinct from oh:signature, which links a trust block to its detached JWS).

- Domain: `oh:DetachedJws`
- Range: `xsd:string`

### oh:kid

**key id** — Key id selecting the key within the JWK Set; the JWS protected header's 'kid' must equal it.

- Domain: `oh:KeyRef`
- Range: `xsd:string`

### oh:probeExpect

**probe expectation** — What answer proves liveness; one of the closed oh:ProbeExpectValue set.

- Domain: `oh:Probe`
- Range: `oh:ProbeExpectValue`

### oh:probeKind

**probe kind** — The kind of liveness probe to send; one of the closed oh:ProbeKindValue set.

- Domain: `oh:Probe`
- Range: `oh:ProbeKindValue`

### oh:schemaVersion

**schema version** — The format version of a published envelope document (the directory envelope's 'version' field). Named oh:schemaVersion, not oh:version, to keep it unmistakably apart from owl:versionInfo and from entry/organisation version resources (oh:versionOf).

- Range: `xsd:string`

### oh:signedAt

**signed at** — Operator-declared signing time (RFC 3339, UTC). A newly signed card is a re-verification event (E09 no. 2).

- Domain: `oh:Authenticity`
- Range: `xsd:dateTime`

### oh:slug

**slug** — The entry's display slug (lowercase, hyphenated). Display only: the stable internal organisation ID is a separate identifier (E14) — slugs may change, identity URIs never do.

- Domain: `oh:RegistryEntry`
- Range: `xsd:string`

### oh:tier

**tier** — The interface's service tier (Stufen-Prinzip, VISION §4); one of the closed oh:TierValue set.

- Domain: `oh:Interface`
- Range: `oh:TierValue`

### oh:verifiedAt

**verified at** — Time of the Verein's out-of-band verification act (RFC 3339, UTC).

- Domain: `oh:Attestation`
- Range: `xsd:dateTime`

## Annotation properties

### oh:importsTerm

**imports term** — Documentation-only registry of the foreign terms this ontology references (the machine-readable mirror of imports/README.md). Foreign terms are imported, never re-declared: they appear in this file only in object position (E16 no. 5e).

## Value datatypes

### oh:AttestationLevelValue

**attestation level value** — Closed value set of oh:attestationLevel (card spec v0.1; gradient per E14(b)).

- Notes:
  - Allowed value 'countersigned': the Verein verified identity out of band and countersigns for an operator without own key management (E09 no. 4).
  - Allowed value 'identity-verified': the out-of-band key-to-legal-entity binding was checked.
  - Allowed value 'deep-verified': additionally the credential-path deep check passed (E14(b)2).

### oh:AuthTypeValue

**auth type value** — Closed value set of oh:authType (manifest standard v0.1).

- Notes:
  - Allowed value 'none': no authentication required.
  - Allowed value 'apikey': a static API key is required.
  - Allowed value 'oauth2': an OAuth 2.0 flow is required.
  - Allowed value 'other': another mechanism, described in the auth block's oh:documentation.

### oh:ProbeExpectValue

**probe expectation value** — Closed value set of oh:probeExpect (L0.8).

- Notes:
  - Allowed value 'ok': a 2xx answer is required.
  - Allowed value 'boolean': a SPARQL ASK result document is required.
  - Allowed value 'response': any HTTP answer proves liveness (bot walls included).

### oh:ProbeKindValue

**probe kind value** — Closed value set of oh:probeKind (L0.8).

- Notes:
  - Allowed value 'sparql-ask': send a SPARQL ASK query.
  - Allowed value 'http-get': send an HTTP GET request.
  - Allowed value 'http-head': send an HTTP HEAD request.
  - Allowed value 'mcp-initialize': perform an MCP initialize handshake. Handshake-era servers only — the stateless revision has no initialize method.
  - Allowed value 'mcp-discover': send server/discover as the first message, in the stateless per-request envelope.

### oh:TierValue

**tier value** — Closed value set of oh:tier (Stufen-Prinzip, VISION §4).

- Notes:
  - Allowed value 'base': stateless/cheap base tier (published zero tariff, E16 no. 2).
  - Allowed value 'semantic': semantic tier.
  - Allowed value 'generative': generative tier.
